‭It is estimated that over 600,000 ethnic Azerbaijanis fled the region as a result of the First‬
‭Nagorno-Karabakh War, being forced to live in squalor refugee camps across Azerbaijan. While some‬
‭Armenians were also displaced, we must note that it was primarily Azerbaijanis who were forced to leave‬
‭when Armenia gained control of the region. This historical context is important to our approach with‬
‭Nagorno-Karabakh because we must uphold Azerbaijan’s territorial integrity over the Nagoeno-Karabakh‬
